semantics: Per entity/revision, run/attempt and condition. States do not persist across invalidating mutations. No runtime engine is supplied.

PART_DIM.when: dimension_receipt.accepted AND same cell_id AND same CAD_revision

PART_CHANNEL.when: channel_receipt.accepted AND dimensional_accepted for same cell_id/CAD_revision

ASM_LOWER_QC.when: every first-layer recipe slot passes identity, orientation and join checks

ASM_QC.when: all declared layers/slots accepted AND all geometry/seam checks accepted at same assembly revision

CAL_REVIEW.when: calibration accepted AND current sensor/channel/gain/time/geometry within declared validity scope

GRID_FAR.when: nonempty grid qualified for current selected condition/run/attempt; preserve those IDs

GRID_NEAR.when: nonempty grid qualified for current selected condition/run/attempt; preserve those IDs

NEXT_POINT.when: all points classified or acquisition fault stopped work

all scheduled grid keys accepted with compatible identities

location_bridge: Successful MOVE plus observed destination maps to at_fabrication, at_inspection, at_assembly, at_waveguide, at_calibration or at_archive for its retained payload only.
safety_bridge: Initial source-off or emergency shutdown comes from independent readback. MUTE may be requested any time, including abort; no scan-completion prerequisite.
records_bridge: records_committed covers declared acquisition attempts including failure. A no-acquisition preparation route declares an explicit empty acquisition allocation and still archives fabrication/inspection receipts; it cannot count as an experiment.
acceptance_rule: Dimensional and channel checks must both accept the same cell/CAD revision before assembly; layer/array/calibration rejection never sets an accepted state.
scan_rule: FFT requires a complete accepted grid. Partial-grid processing is a separately labeled extension and cannot close a source route.
reset_rule: Changing sample geometry, component graph, sensor mounting, gain or relevant coordinate frame invalidates out-of-scope acceptance/calibration/reference states.

prepared_state_handoffs.APPARATUS_to_QUALIFY_CHAIN: Source and ambient chain prepared, stage frame known, output off. Probe is parked, supported, disconnected and removed via PROBE_RELEASE before calibration transport; remount, SOURCE_WIRE and DAQ_WIRE verify current setup after return. Terminal teardown is deferred until episode end.
prepared_state_handoffs.QUALIFY_CHAIN_to_measurement: Valid scoped calibration/reference, observed connected source/probe/DAQ, qualified stage/frame, output off. Recheck all changes before ARM.

probe_transport_invalidation: PROBE_RELEASE clears microphone_mounted and channels_mapped for probe channels; MIC_MOUNT/DAQ_WIRE restore observed setup and require validity recheck.
first_point_bridge: GRID_FAR or GRID_NEAR selects first point only after current condition/attempt frame and grid qualify. NEXT_POINT selects remaining points without allocating a new run.
